design-system.headline: [Project] — an admin panel people stop fighting with.

story.text: [What hurt users or the business. Example shape: finding one record meant opening a hidden filter panel and losing the list.]

body.text: A row opens in a [[side drawer]], so the list stays in view. The main action — [[Approve]] — sits at the bottom where the thumb and eye end up.
Operators [[tick several rows]] and a [[bulk bar]] appears with one status change for all of them.
Every change lands in the [[activity log]] with who did it and when. Updated rows [[turn Active]] in place — no reload.

outcome.text: [Real result only — shipped, adopted, feedback from the team, a metric if you have one.]
